{{Article header|deck=A field reference for Concha Biconcavis, including value, sampling distance, environmental profiles and known visual variants.}}

{{Exobiology species infobox}}

'''Concha Biconcavis''' is a shell-like Concha species. It begins as a ridged, biconcave form that splits open and exposes a thin stalk carrying ring-shaped pods used for chemical exchange.<ref name="canonn">[https://us-central1-canonn-api-236217.cloudfunctions.net/query/codex/ref Canonn Codex reference], snapshot retrieved 28 September 2026.</ref>

== Identification ==

Unopened specimens resemble ridged, bisected shells; mature growths are easier to recognise by the central stalk and its ringed pods.
